goal: Independently integrate exact original PFFDTD Cartesian rigid Neumann source-connected graph using scipy CSR sparse matrix-vector recurrence rather than upstream PFFDTD Numba air/boundary in/out kernels, to test full untruncated original 8-node q0 waveform against each raw SHA-pinned original upstream 8-node 0.25s output for PPW28/32/36/40/44. Do not modify any native solver or input.

original_inputs.original_source: exact 8 native in_ixyz and in_sigs[:,0], all later native in_sigs=0; original volume velocity q[0]=1
original_inputs.original_receiver: exact 8 original out_ixyz/output node raw traces and original out_alpha from comms
original_inputs.original_time: native Ts/Nt frozen 0.25s, 40/80Hz finite P_T/Q_T from same second order pressure derivative and rho=1.2
original_inputs.room_boundary: unchanged original Neumann voxel-mask graph with exactly zero asymmetric edges and no halo connections

independent_solver.method: fully untruncated CSR matrix-vector leapfrog u_next=2*u_current-u_previous-l2*A@u_current; inject exact native in_sigs[:,n] after update; raw receiver node samples u_current before injection each n
independent_solver.L: A=degree I minus adjacency, precomputed from original source-connected 6-neighbour graph; exact HDF5 pins
independent_solver.sampling: native output raw 8xNt plus native 8 weights; check raw arrays and recombined potential and full original pressure transfer; no artificial taper
independent_solver.time_integrator: native same second order recurrence but mathematically separate sparse CSR implementation; not independent physical solver and not a proof of spatial continuum convergence
independent_solver.energy_check: for any n>=1 following q0 source, discrete homogeneous energy E_n=||u_n-u_(n-1)||^2/l2 + u_n^T A u_(n-1), at n=1, n=Nt/4, n=Nt/2, n=Nt-1; preserve actual signed drift
independent_solver.source_aliasing: if multiple original native source nodes coincide, explicit numpy.add.at
